Democracy Defender Mod Manager (Ordnance), release candidate 9: *your mods, your democracy, defended.* It's still an
early build, but it's meant to be usable by anyone, not just developers.

**The Ordnance Promise, in brief:** every mod is welcome (Ordnance never blocks, blacklists or ranks mods or mod sites),
no account is ever needed on any site, your files stay in a folder you control, it's Apache-2.0 open source
forever, and update checks never run unless you ask.

## Quick start

1. **Download** the right file for you (see the table below).
2. **Run it.** Ordnance looks for your Helldivers 2 install automatically. If Steam is in its usual place, there's
   nothing to set up.
3. **Add mods and click Deploy.** Drag in an archive or folder, or click "Add URL" and paste a link.

**Works with AyakaMods, Nexus Mods, ModWorkshop, GameBanana, GitHub, any direct link, or files already on your
disk.** Special love to the AyakaMods community ❤️, one of the best homes for Helldivers 2 modding. Go say hi:
<https://ayakamods.com/games/helldivers-2.119/>.

## Which file do I download?

| You want... | Download |
| --- | --- |
| A normal install on Windows (Start Menu shortcut, uninstaller) | `Ordnance-2.0.0-rc.9-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows without installing anything (unzip and run) | `Ordnance-2.0.0-rc.9-windows-x64-portable.zip` |
| Linux: Fedora, Nobara, openSUSE (`dnf`/`zypper`) | `Ordnance-2.0.0-rc.9-linux-x86_64.rpm` |
| Linux: Debian, Ubuntu, Mint (`apt`) | `Ordnance-2.0.0-rc.9-linux-amd64.deb` |
| Linux: other distros, no install (uses your desktop's graphics libraries) | `Ordnance-2.0.0-rc.9-linux-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Linux: Arch/CachyOS, or just the binary (needs WebKitGTK 4.1) | `Ordnance-2.0.0-rc.9-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

Linux install commands, the dependencies for each distro, and fixes for a blank window or AppImage/FUSE errors
are in [Installing on Linux](https://katsyk.github.io/DemocracyDefenderModManager/getting-started/linux/).

**One-click install (optional):** also grab the browser extension: `ordnance-extension-chrome-1.0.0.zip`
(Chrome, Edge, Brave) or `ordnance-extension-firefox-1.0.0.zip` (Firefox). See
[One-click install](https://katsyk.github.io/DemocracyDefenderModManager/using/one-click-install/).

Check `SHA256SUMS.txt` if you want to verify your download.

## What's new in 2.0.0-rc.9

### Mods that wouldn't install (#33)

Some mods refused to install, or failed with an unhelpful error. That's fixed:

- Ordnance now waits for your browser to actually finish downloading a mod, instead of grabbing the unfinished file.
- Archives are recognised by what's inside them, not by their extension, so a `.rar` that's named `.zip` still
  works.
- `.7z` files that use Deflate compression now open.
- If two mods have the same ID, Ordnance now tells you clearly which mod already has it.
- When an install does fail, Ordnance now tells you which step failed, why, and what you can do about it.

### One-click links (#32)

Clicking an install link while Ordnance wasn't already running now opens Ordnance and shows the install prompt, instead
of nothing happening.

## Known limitations

- **Windows builds are unsigned.** Windows SmartScreen will likely show a warning the first time you run the
  installer or the app. Click **"More info" → "Run anyway"** to continue.
- **The Linux .rpm and .deb are unsigned**, so openSUSE needs `zypper install --allow-unsigned-rpm`.
- **This is still a release candidate.** Expect some rough edges, and please report what you find.
